why: Backfill of tasks.related_table='leads'. These 5 rows were created by the New Lead form on admin/people.html (and lead-detail's createTask, which writes the same pair). task_list and va_daily_tasks read `related_table is not null` as 'a machine made this', so all 5 were reported as automation output when a person typed them. Surface 2 moved the writer onto task_upsert, which has no related_table parameter; this is the historical data.
note_on_related_id: related_id held the lead id. On 2 rows it points at a contact that NO LONGER EXISTS (9ba441a9, 8fbc02cf) - those pointers are preserved here and nowhere else. On 1 row (1a1b44b6) it was the ONLY link to a live contact, Dora Munoz Cruz, because contact_id was null; that link is recovered into contact_id rather than dropped.
